# vk 0.11.0 — `new()` record constructors

Development release, 2026-11-05. Cargo package **`vkrust 0.11.0+1.4.365`**,
Rust library/import name **`vk`**, Git tag **`v0.11.0`**, MIT licensed.
The `+1.4.365` suffix identifies the unchanged pinned Vulkan header snapshot;
it is not a Vulkan 1.4 driver requirement.

[Developer guide](https://dev.realm.software/vk) ·
[Rust API reference](https://docs.rs/vkrust/latest/vk/) ·
[Realm](https://realm.software/)

## API and migration

This is a source-compatible minor API release: every generated Vulkan record
and every public `vk::mem` configuration or snapshot record with `Default`
gains `Type::new()`, delegating to its existing `Default` implementation:

```rust
let application = vk::ApplicationInfo::new()
    .set_application_name(c"vk example")
    .set_api_version(vk::API_VERSION_1_0);
let info = vk::InstanceCreateInfo::new()
    .set_application_info(&application);
```

`Default` remains the single initialization source and trait entry point:
canonical `sType` tags, null `pNext` and zeroed fields are identical under
either spelling, and `..Default::default()` struct-update syntax is unchanged.
`Type::default()` stays valid; `new()` is the crate's construction vocabulary
alongside `Type::new(...)`, `new_from_*` and `new_with_*` for owned objects.

The public `vk::mem` records `DebugMemorySettings`, `DeviceMemoryCallbacks`,
`AllocationCreateInfo`, `AllocatorStats`, `HeapBudget`, `BudgetSnapshot`,
`TrimStats`, `PoolCreateInfo`, `PoolStats`, `DefragmentationInfo`,
`DefragmentationStats`, `DetailedStatistics` and `MemoryStatistics` carry the
same contract.

Unchanged:

- existing constructors such as `Allocator::new*`, `MemoryPriority::new`,
  `VirtualBlock::new*`, `DefragmentationContext::new` and
  `AllocationChain::new_from_record*`;
- `#[default]` enums and records without a `Default` implementation;
- `Default` trait implementations, which `new()` delegates to rather than
  replaces;
- signatures, fields, lifetimes, dispatch and the native ABI.

## Evidence and limits

The release checkpoint passed the workspace test and doctest suite — including
generated per-record contract tests proving `new()` signatures and canonical
`sType`/`pNext` initial state, and the `vk::mem`
`record_constructors_delegate_to_default` proof — plus strict Clippy, rustfmt
and the generator's `--check` idempotence gate on the private tree. Release CI
reruns the configured tests, package/consumer checks and pinned-header oracles
on this release's exact public snapshot.

No new sanitizer, VMA donor or native-hardware qualification was run for this
delta; `new()` adds an alias over recorded initialization paths. The allocator
remains Experimental; all existing qualification limits continue to apply —
see the [qualification report](../qualification.md). No production readiness
claim follows from this release.
